probe.title: Sustainability | Floema® — Spaces for people, made for life.
probe.text_sample: Sustainability | Floema® — Spaces for people, made for life. Built in Portugal. Made for life. True sustainability demands timeless design as well as enduring materials. We design, build, and implement products that are functional, viable in the long term, and aesthetically pleasing. Built to resist adverse conditions, seasonal changes, constant use, and harsh surroundings. Requiring little to no maintenance, making them both weather and future-proof Cities have the ability to offer something for everyone, just because, and only when, they are created by everyone. " At Floema, we want the environment on our side.
